_comment: Octail curated egg (plan §6.4). Based on games-steamcmd svencoop/egg-sven-co-op.json (pelican-eggs, MIT licence), on Octail's source image (32-bit libraries, with OpenSSL 3 and zlib for svends_i686) instead of steamcmd:debian. Octail adds the sven-co-op, svencoop, goldsrc tags, max players (+maxplayers), a map name of letters, digits, _ and -, an RCON password hidden from customers (+rcon_password only when set, so an empty one doesn't override server.cfg; since Octail has no GoldSrc RCON client the console is the container's stdin), the Players tab (A2S list, kick by name over the console) and the Steam query (A2S) for player counts, start detection by the Steam connection line with the UDP game port as a fallback (ready after 30 s), generic UDP idle sleep (off until staff enable it per server), the say broadcast, the update before start (AUTO_UPDATE, on by default), install sandbox defaults and resource hints, anonymous SteamCMD only, and makes the install fail when SteamCMD didn't download the server. SteamCMD is retried up to 3 times: its first run on a fresh install often fails with "Missing configuration". The server name, password and region stay in svencoop/server.cfg (upstream rewrote them at every start); the 32-bit steamclient.so is copied too (svends_i686 is 32-bit; upstream had it commented out). The SteamCMD download times out and retries instead of hanging the install.
name: Sven Co-op
author: octail@meowgafactory.com
description: Sven Co-op, the free co-operative Half-Life mod on the GoldSrc engine: up to 32 players against monsters through Half-Life, Opposing Force and custom campaigns.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Sven Co-op Dedicated Server (app 276060) Installation Script
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server
# Based on the pelican-eggs Sven Co-op egg (games-steamcmd svencoop, MIT licence).
#
# Variables
# SRCDS_APPID - 276060 (Sven Co-op Dedicated Server, anonymous)
# SRCDS_BETAID - an optional beta branch

## Sven Co-op's dedicated server installs anonymously
STEAM_USER=anonymous

## download and install steamcmd
cd /tmp || exit 1
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd
## Octail: time out and retry instead of hanging the install when the download stalls
curl -fsSL --connect-timeout 30 --max-time 300 --retry 3 -o steamcmd.tar.gz https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz || { echo "Could not download SteamCMD; try reinstalling."; exit 1; }
tar -xzvf steamcmd.tar.gz -C /mnt/server/steamcmd
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamapps # Fix steamcmd disk write error when this folder is missing
cd /mnt/server/steamcmd || exit 1

# SteamCMD fails otherwise for some reason, even running as root.
# This is changed at the end of the install process anyways.
chown -R root:root /mnt
export HOME=/mnt/server

## install game using steamcmd
beta=()
[[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAID} ]] || beta=(-beta "${SRCDS_BETAID}")
## Octail: SteamCMD's first run often fails with "Missing configuration"; try up to 3 times
for steamcmd_try in 1 2 3; do
    if ./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login "${STEAM_USER}" +app_update "${SRCDS_APPID}" "${beta[@]}" validate +quit; then break; fi
    echo "SteamCMD did not finish (attempt $steamcmd_try of 3)"
done

## set up 32 bit libraries (svends_i686 is a 32-bit server)
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32
cp -v linux32/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so

## set up 64 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64
cp -v linux64/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so

## Octail: fail the install when SteamCMD didn't download the server
if [[ ! -f "/mnt/server/svends_run" || ! -f "/mnt/server/svends_i686" ]]; then
    echo -e "\nSteamCMD failed to install the Sven Co-op dedicated server; try reinstalling."
    exit 1
fi

## Empty ban lists, so the first start doesn't complain that it can't exec them; existing ones are kept
for cfg in listip.cfg banned.cfg; do
    [[ -f "/mnt/server/svencoop/${cfg}" ]] || touch "/mnt/server/svencoop/${cfg}"
done

## install end
echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Installation completed..."
echo "-----------------------------------------"

variables.name: App ID
variables.description: The Steam app id of the Sven Co-op Dedicated Server.

variables.name: Map
variables.description: The first map, for example svencoop1, svencoop2, hl_c01_a1 or stadium4.

variables.name: RCON Password
variables.description: GoldSrc RCON password (rcon_password) for RCON tools and the in-game rcon command, passed only when set. Hidden from customers: staff set it; empty leaves RCON to the game folder's server.cfg (rcon_password), off when that has none. The panel console doesn't need it.

variables.name: Beta branch
variables.description: An optional Steam beta branch; empty for the public build. Reinstall after changing it.

variables.name: Auto-update server
variables.description: Check for a server update with SteamCMD at every start (1 on, 0 off).
